name: Ascalon
description:
Deals Damage to <@ba.kw>all targets</> within range
50% chance to dodge Physical and Arts attacks and is less likely to be <@ba.kw>targeted</> by enemies

candidates.name: Mortal Interrogation
candidates.description: Attacks inflict the following effect on enemies: Movement Speed reduced by 12% and take 6% of Ascalon's current ATK as Arts damage per second for 18s, stacking up to 3 times.

candidates.name: Mortal Interrogation
candidates.description: Attacks inflict the following effect on enemies: Movement Speed reduced by 15% and take 8% of Ascalon's current ATK as Arts damage per second for 18s, stacking up to 3 times.

candidates.name: Mortal Interrogation
candidates.description: Attacks inflict the following effect on enemies: Movement Speed reduced by 18% and take 10% of Ascalon's current ATK as Arts damage per second for 25s, stacking up to 3 times.

candidates.name: Penumbral Image
candidates.description: ASPD +8; gain an additional ASPD +6 if there is high ground in the 4 adjacent tiles.

candidates.name: Penumbral Image
candidates.description: ASPD +10 <@ba.talpu>(+2)</>; gain an additional ASPD +6 if there is high ground in the 4 adjacent tiles.
